Protocol Testing: Ability to sniff and analyse communication protocols between ground and air (IRONBIRD) to de-risk command-and-control latency and packet loss.</p> <p>· HIL/SIL Setup: Experience building and maintaining Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) environments to simulate flight triggers on the bench.</p> <p>· Environmental &amp; Stress Testing: Competence in vibration, thermal, and EMI (Electromagnetic Interference) "torture tests" on supporting hardware to ensure field survivability.</p> <p>· Diagnostic Tooling: Skilled in the use of oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, and network protocol analysers to perform root-cause analysis on ground-side hardware failures.</p> <p><em data-renderer-mark="true"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically</em>&nbsp;<em data-stringify-type="italic">under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.</em></em></p> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <p>· Bachelor's degree (B.Sc. or B.Eng.) in a relevant engineering discipline.</p> <p>· Prior exposure to defense, dual-use, or regulated hardware in a test context is strongly preferred.</p> <p>· Experience in an aerospace or defense environment operating under ITAR/EAR or equivalent national defense export control frameworks is an advantage.</p> <h2><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields</span><span data-ccp-props="{">&nbsp;</span></strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Helsing’s work is important. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world</span></p> </li> <li> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward</span></p> </li> <li> <p><span data-contrast="auto">In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts</span></p> </li> <li> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about</span></p> </li> </ul> <h2 id="What-we-offer" data-renderer-start-pos="3238"><span id="6afa48f9-b797-428b-aa69-0bc8163b3593" data-renderer-mark="true" data-mark-type="annotation" data-mark-annotation-type="inlineComment" data-id="6afa48f9-b797-428b-aa69-0bc8163b3593">What we offer</span></h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Competitive salary </strong>and<strong> VSOP options</strong></p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Relocation support</strong>: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Learning</strong>: €500/£450 yearly allowance</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Health &amp; wellness</strong>: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Social</strong>: regular company events and monthly social allowances</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Enhanced parental leave</strong>: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers &amp; 6 weeks for secondary caregivers</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Family support:</strong> 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work</p> </li> <li> <p>A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.</span><span data-ccp-props="{">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.</span><span data-ccp-props="{">&nbsp;</span></span></p> </div> <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <div> <p>As an Environment Test Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, execution, and analysis of environmental stress test campaigns across the full range of drone sub-systems and Ground Support Equipment (GSE). As a generalist within the Environmental Cluster, you will apply your knowledge to mechanical, thermal, and environmental qualification—across multiple hardware domains. The Environmental Cluster is the "Physical Reality" team within the Test Department. Where other clusters validate functionality, the Environmental Cluster validates survivability and performance under real-world stress.</p> <p>The cluster is organized around domain specialists—Launch Systems, Ground Communication Systems—but requires a generalist backbone to ensure test coverage continuity across all sub-systems, absorb campaign overflows from specialist engineers, and extend the cluster's capability into emerging and sensitive hardware domains.</p> </div> <h2>The day-to-day</h2> <ul> <li>Vibration &amp; Shock Campaigns: Designing and executing vibration test campaigns (sine sweep, random vibration, shock) on drone sub-systems and GSE hardware to simulate transport, operational, and launch-induced dynamic environments.</li> <li>Thermal Soak &amp; Cycling: Executing controlled thermal exposure tests across the full operational temperature range on any sub-system assigned by the Head of Testing or cluster lead.</li> <li>IP &amp; Ingress Testing: Executing dust and water ingress tests on drone enclosures, connectors, and GSE hardware to validate field survivability.</li> <li>Humidity, Salt Spray &amp; Corrosion: Running humidity-controlled and salt-spray campaigns to identify corrosion risks in connectors, structural joints, and electronic housings.</li> <li>Altitude Simulation: Validating component behaviour under simulated low-pressure conditions relevant to the operational altitude range of the drone.</li> <li>Fatigue &amp; raw.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Senior CSM at 1Password, you own and strategically manage a portfolio of customers – driving value realization, revenue retention, and expansion outcomes that consistently exceed expectations. You operate with full commercial autonomy: advancing expansion opportunities independently, engaging VP and C-suite stakeholders as a trusted advisor, and managing complex renewals without escalation. Beyond your own book, you raise the bar for the team through mentorship, playbook contributions, and peer enablement.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

  • 6+ years in a customer-facing, consultative, or technical role in SaaS – Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, or IT/security leadership.

  • Demonstrated track record of exceeding retention, adoption, and expansion outcomes; experience recognized with performance distinction is a plus.

  • Proven ability to run executive business reviews with VP and C-suite stakeholders.

  • Background in cybersecurity, IAM, identity security, or enterprise IT preferred; former 1Password power user is a strong plus.

  • Strategic success planning and multi-threaded stakeholder management across a complex portfolio.

  • Commercial acumen: independently qualifies, advances, and documents expansion opportunities; manages negotiations without oversight.

  • Designs and applies AI-assisted workflows to commercial execution; documents use cases in a shareable format.

  • Strong Gainsight and Salesforce hygiene; consistent forecasting discipline.

  • Highly autonomous; manages complex accounts without requiring managerial direction.

  • Commercial thinker who connects customer outcomes to expansion potential naturally.

  • Strong executive presence – adapts messaging across technical, operational, and C-suite audiences.

  • Elevates teammates through knowledge sharing and informal mentorship.

What you can expect:

Own and Grow Your Book of Business

  • Independently manage a portfolio of moderately to highly complex accounts – adapting success plans to each customer’s context without manager guidance.

  • Maintain full success plan coverage; produce documented best practices and playbooks, applied broadly across accounts with measurable KPI improvement.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate renewal risks; close risk CTAs with a high rate of success within defined timeframes.

Drive Adoption & Value Realization

  • Achieve strong Executive Sponsor attendance in EBRs across segments; EBRs are value-driven, data-backed, and consistently advance renewal confidence.

  • Maintain commercial intelligence across strategic accounts – budget cycles, org changes, compliance mandates, and stack rationalization.

  • Translate advanced 1Password capabilities into clear outcomes for VP and C-suite stakeholders; tie adoption to measurable ROI and long-term advocacy.

Lead Revenue Retention & Expansion

  • Achieve strong amendment and renewal upsell win rates; proactively source and advance expansion opportunities with documented context.

  • Maintain forecasting hygiene with minimal blank or unmodified renewals approaching subscription end.

Operate with Strategic Rigor

  • Manage commercial objections, renewal negotiations, and competitive conversations independently – without escalation for standard to complex scenarios.

  • Build and present business cases to customer champions; advance deals with enough depth to move through the pipeline with AE alignment.

Act as a Trusted Security Advisor

  • Deep working knowledge of the full 1Password product suite; design tailored success journeys connecting feature adoption to measurable business outcomes.

  • Incorporate regulatory context, breach patterns, and competitive dynamics into EBRs with confidence.

  • Design and share AI-assisted workflows with teammates in a replicable, documented format.

Collaborate & Enable

  • Lead joint account planning with your AE; cited by AEs as a proactive commercial collaborator who improves deal outcomes.

  • Mentor Level B CSMs through call shadowing, ad hoc coaching, or onboarding support.

  • Lead or co-lead cross-team initiatives; contribute tools or improvements adopted by peers.

Month 1 – Onboarding & Foundation

  • Develop fluency in 1Password’s full product suite, CS methodology, and commercial motion.

  • By the end of Month 1, you will independently manage customer touchpoints and demonstrate clear understanding of renewal drivers across your portfolio.

Month 3 – Portfolio Ownership

  • Full ownership of your book with consistent EBR cadence and expansion sourcing.

  • By Month 3, you are meeting key performance targets and expansion leads are flowing to Sales with documented context.

Month 6 – Strategic Impact

  • Operating at full commercial autonomy; contributing to team practices and mentoring peers.

  • By Month 6, you are achieving top-tier customer satisfaction and recognized as a reliable commercial collaborator by your AE and cross-functional partners.

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £73,000 GBP and £106,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at ----- and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

title: General Manager, Trainline Media
description: About us At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels. Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet. We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel. Introducing the Trainline Media Team 👋 Trainline Media is an emerging part of Trainline's strategy, with real momentum behind it. The team brings together sales, advertising operations, client success and strategy, and is moving from an early pilot into its next phase of growth. It sits within a business where advertising is one part of a broader, operationally focused whole. This role suits someone who enjoys building: shaping team culture, defining how the function works and making thoughtful, steady progress. As General Manager, Trainline Media, you will work closely with colleagues across the business, taking the time to understand how Trainline operates and aligning change with its wider priorities. In your first six to twelve months, you will help sharpen how Trainline Media presents itself to the market, focus the team on the right priorities and put in place the operational foundations needed to grow, balancing commercial growth with operational effectiveness. In this role as the General Manager, Trainline Media, you will...🚄 Set the direction for Trainline Media, shaping its proposition, target market and growth priorities so it becomes a trusted travel media offering. Take ownership of Trainline Media's revenue targets, working with senior stakeholders to align its goals with wider business priorities. Partner with colleagues across Product, Data, PR and Marketing to develop the proposition and bring it to market. Represent Trainline Media externally, building awareness and credibility with the media and advertising buying community through an active industry presence. Lead and grow a team of more than ten people across sales, advertising operations, client success and strategy, creating a culture where people want to join and develop. Design the operating model, processes and measures needed to scale the business, including client delivery and billing, using data and AI tools to help the team work smarter. Balance commercial growth with operational effectiveness, so the function delivers sustainably as it grows. We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍 Experience building and scaling a media or advertising function, ideally within a larger, operationally focused consumer technology business. A solid understanding of brand media, with the ability to position and grow an emerging proposition. Experience across performance media is also helpful if you have it. Experience leading and growing large teams, and creating an environment where people can do their best work. Experience owning revenue targets and designing the processes, operating rhythms and measures that support sustainable, scalable growth. Sound judgement in balancing competing priorities, working constructively in a business where advertising is one of several revenue streams, and turning ambiguity into clear priorities and practical action. A collaborative, diplomatic leadership style, with the ability to build trust and influence senior stakeholders. Curiosity about how data and AI tools can improve the way a team works, and ideally some experience putting them to use. An active presence in the media industry, or a keen interest in building one, and the confidence to represent the business externally. More information: Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy. Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 🤝 Travel Together - We're one team ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated. raw.title: Senior Technical Support Analyst
raw.description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Workplace Technology team at Trainline 👋

Our Workplace Technology team owns and manages the corporate technology stack of business and workplace solutions, driving innovative, cost efficient, future ways of working.

The Tech Support team is a critical part of the Workplace Technology team, ensuring Tier 2 and Tier 3 support services are delivered effectively and efficiently within a culture of continual service improvement, aligned to Trainline values.

The team is principally responsible for end user computing across a MacOS estate under central management using JAMF Pro, and a Microsoft Windows estate integrated with Azure Active Directory and Microsoft Windows Servers. This is a highly visible team, also providing dedicated AV/VC support for meeting rooms and internal events — ensuring high availability, instilling trust, and enabling a seamless experience for Executive-level presenters.

About the Role

This is not just a senior technical position — it is a leadership role within the team. We are looking for someone who takes genuine ownership: of problems, of standards, of team capability, and of the overall service we deliver to Trainliners. You will be the go-to person when things get complex, the one who sets the bar for quality, and the one who actively lifts others to reach it.

You will work closely with the Workplace Technology Lead, acting as a technical anchor for the team — driving consistency, mentoring your peers, championing best practices, and making sure nothing important falls through the cracks. If you see something that isn't right, you fix it. If a junior engineer is stuck, you help them through it. If a process is broken, you own improving it.

As a Senior IT Support Analyst, you'll be responsible for... 🚝

Technical Leadership & Team Ownership

• Acting as the technical escalation point for the team — owning complex incidents end-to-end and ensuring nothing stalls without clear direction

• Mentoring and upskilling junior and mid-level engineers: pairing on problems, reviewing their work, and sharing knowledge deliberately and consistently

• Setting and maintaining quality standards for ticket management, documentation, and technical investigations across the team

• Driving team readiness — identifying skill gaps, flagging them to the Lead, and taking initiative to close them through coaching or knowledge sessions

• Leading by example in attitude, thoroughness, communication, and follow-through — shaping the team culture through daily behaviour

• Supporting the Workplace Technology Lead with operational decisions, workload balancing, and service improvements

Incident, Problem & Request Management

• Owning the full incident lifecycle for complex and high-priority issues — from triage and investigation through to resolution and post-incident review

• Conducting deep root cause analysis: reviewing logs, correlating cross-system patterns, engaging third-party vendors, and documenting findings clearly

• Ensuring the team's ticket queue is healthy — proactively monitoring dashboards, reassigning where needed, and preventing SLA breaches before they happen

• Driving problem management: identifying recurring incidents, initiating investigations, and leading permanent fix efforts rather than accepting repeat workarounds

• Owning escalation quality — ensuring issues are fully investigated, clearly documented, and appropriately packaged before being escalated to Tier 3 or vendors

Microsoft 365, Azure AD & Identity Management

• Advanced administration of Microsoft 365 services: Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and the M365 Security & Compliance Centre

• Azure Active Directory: user and group lifecycle, Conditional Access policy design and troubleshooting, SSPR, MFA enforcement, and RBAC

• Leading SSO/SAML integrations for new SaaS platforms — configuring, testing, and documenting alongside the security team

• Owning access package governance and token management processes, ensuring alignment with policy and audit requirements

• Supporting licence governance: E3/E5 procurement, assignment, cost awareness, and flagging any out-of-policy requests to the appropriate stakeholder

AV/VC & Events Support

• Taking ownership of the AV/VC estate — maintaining full health of meeting room systems including display hardware, conferencing codecs, room controllers, and peripherals

• Proactive health monitoring using remote administration tools, with performance analytics and regular firmware/software updates

• Leading in-person and remote technical delivery for internal events and Executive/all-hands presentations

• Acting as the senior point of contact for AV issues, ensuring fast resolution and minimal meeting disruption across all sites

• Documenting AV configurations and building runbooks that enable the wider team to support the estate confidently

End User Computing & Device Management

• Advanced MacOS and Windows 11 management via JAMF Pro and Microsoft Intune/Autopilot — including policy authoring, troubleshooting complex deployment failures, and estate-wide configuration management

• Overseeing the quality of on/off-boarding processes: laptop builds, IT inductions, IAM compliance, deprovisioning, and asset retrieval

• Driving IT Asset Management maturity: inventory accuracy, lifecycle planning, hardware refresh adherence, and secure disposal compliance

• Working knowledge of Android and Linux environments; able to support edge cases confidently

Security, Compliance & Governance

• Championing security standards across the team — ensuring all activity aligns with ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and internal policy

• Leading the team's contribution to audit and compliance reviews: ensuring evidence is well-organised, processes are followed, and findings are acted on

• Owning the leavers process for sensitive cases — coordinating deprovisioning, data access controls, and asset recovery in line with CISO and privacy requirements

• Supporting MFA rollout, access policy governance, and SSO governance initiatives with appropriate rigour and documentation

• Ensuring all advice given to the team is backed by security sign-off and documented reference — not informal Slack approvals

Documentation, Process & Continuous Improvement

• Owning and continuously improving the team's knowledge base — SOPs, runbooks, known error records, and onboarding guides must be accurate, accessible, and up to date

• Identifying process inefficiencies and owning their improvement: not just flagging them but designing, implementing, and embedding the fix

• Driving automation and tooling improvements — proposing and where possible implementing AI, ML, and scripting solutions that reduce toil and improve consistency

• Ensuring approvals, decisions, and audit trails live in the ticketing system — not in Slack channels

Our Tech Stack requires solid experience of 🔑

• Windows 11 and Apple ecosystem in an enterprise environment (+ working knowledge of Android & Linux)

• Mobile Device Management: JAMF Pro and Microsoft Intune — policy creation, complex troubleshooting, and deployment strategy

• Microsoft 365 administration — Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and M365 Security & Compliance Centre

• Azure Active Directory — user lifecycle, Conditional Access, SSPR, MFA, and RBAC at an administrative level

• Modern workplace solutions: Autopilot, Intune, MFA, and cloud migration strategies

• Platform integrations, SSO/SAML — configuration, fault diagnosis, and documentation

• AV/VC hardware and software: room systems, conferencing platforms, and peripheral management

• Networks: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN, WAN, and wireless

• Windows Command Line / PowerShell & Apple Scripting / BASH — beyond basics; able to write and adapt scripts

• SaaS applications including Slack, Atlassian suite, and cloud printing solutions

• ITSM platforms: lifecycle ticket management, SLA reporting, and queue ownership

• Security tools, best practices, PCI-DSS, and ISO 27001

• Runbook authoring and technical documentation to a high standard

Desirable Certifications:

• Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)

• Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert or Security Administrator Associate

• Azure fundamentals

• Apple certifications for MacOS: ACSP (ACTC), JAMF 100

• CompTIA A+ or Network+

• ITIL Foundation v4 or V5

We'd love to hear from you if you... 🔍

• Take genuine ownership — you don't wait to be told, you see what needs doing and you do it

• Have the technical depth to anchor a team: complex problems don't rattle you, they motivate you

• Actively lift those around you — you share knowledge freely, coach patiently, and take pride in the team's performance, not just your own

• Communicate with clarity and confidence at all levels, from a junior engineer to an Executive stakeholder

• Conduct thorough, methodical investigations — you dig into logs, correlate patterns, and document what you find before reaching conclusions

• Have a genuine security-first mindset and understand why governance and audit trails matter

• Spot broken processes and own fixing them — not just flagging them

• Work autonomously under pressure, exercising sound judgement and knowing when to escalate

• Are happy to be onsite as needed, including for events and critical incidents

If you're a senior engineer who wants to do more than close tickets — who wants to shape a team, own a service, and leave things better than you found them — this is the role for you.

The Interview Process 🚉

• Recruiter Call

• Competency-based interview with 2x Engineers (45 mins)

• Panel interview with key Workplace Technology stakeholders (30 mins)

Additional Information

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits.

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one!

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe every day, in everything we do:

• 💭 Think Big — We're building the future of rail

• ✔️ Own It — We focus on every customer, partner and journey

• 🤝 Travel Together — We're one team

• ♻️ Do Good — We make a positive impact

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor.

Please note: This role requires 4-5 days a week in our London Farringdon Office.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

investments, and in turn ensure high client satisfaction.&nbsp;</p> <p>Reporting into DTA SVP for Global Reporting Services and the OpenDoor Global DTA Lead, you’ll also be asked to represent the needs of and solutions developed for the client in wider reporting initiatives, and influence the product vision and strategy within this space.</p> <ul> <li>Own reports and data provisioning solutions for the client, taking direct accountability for the quality of the team’s solutions, representing them to clients and working with media leadership to drive successful adoption</li> developers</li> <li>Work with clients and media leadership to establish consensus on the prioritization of requirements for development, using your knowledge of requirements and the technical solution to steer the conversation</li> <li>Lead the design of technical solutions to meet requirements, including the scoping and estimation of work to develop</li> <li>Provide strategic coordination across disciplines on the Amazon account (Media, Measurement/Analytics, Data Excellence, Leadership)</li> <li>Hire, train, and mentor a team of data engineers and reporting specialists, ensuring they have the environment to deliver their best work</li> <li>Provide hands-on leadership, leaning in to support the team when needed, and driving continual improvement in the way we ingest, store, transform and visualize data</li> <li>Partner with Data Excellence, and Engineering as well as Measurement, Analytics and Investment leadership to ensure reporting solutions are incorporating best practice metrics to assess performance, which in turn link to client business goals</li> <li>Be the voice of the client within DTA reporting product and service steering groups, directly influencing the ongoing development of supporting data &amp; technology infrastructure</li> <li>Provide support and training to users of reporting solutions, with the aim of empowering them to be more self-sufficient in overcoming these issues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience as a business intelligence or reporting specialists, preferably at a media agency or related company (e.g. publisher, ad tech, client marketing org)</li> <li>Experience designing and developing intuitive data visualizations with business intelligence software (e.g. PowerBi, Tableau, Looker, Datastudio) that empower end users</li> <li>Strong knowledge of using data infrastructure and cloud data management technologies, as well as data prep and ETL processes, to deliver robust data infrastructure</li> <li>Experience with digital marketing platforms and the data they generate, in particular Google Marketing Platform, Facebook, Twitter etc. Knowledge of their API’s a plus.</li> <li>Experience with WPP Media’s DPAM process and OMS, with particular benefit coming from experience with Campaign Management (formerly Olive) and Campaign Governance (formerly OCTRA)</li> <li>Experience helping set clear strategy, designing technical solutions, proactively managing feature roadmaps, and organizing technical resources to deliver it</li> <li>Excellent and adaptable written and verbal communications style, being able to translate non-technical use cases into technical requirements</li> <li>Strong influencing skills, able to represent and defend your data solutions with senior clients</li> <li>An ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, and directly influence others to drive adoption of solutions and overcome upstream barriers to implementation</li> <li>Experience leading, nurturing and coaching high-performing technical resources</li> <li>A passion for data excellence and integrity, and a commitment to supporting others and providing better solutions to support it.</li> </ul> <p>Desirable</p> <ul> <li>Specific experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), in particular S3, RedShift, and DBT.</li> <li>A general understanding of how data is tracked and exchanged in the process of digital advertising (e.g. role of adservers and other third-party providers of campaign health performance metrics such as DoubleVerify)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to&nbsp;Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to description: <div class="gmail_default" style="font-size: small;"> <div> <p><strong>Why Mozilla?</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser, and Pocket, a service for keeping up with the best content online. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute </span><strong>open-source</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>About this team and role:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re looking for a hands-on Mobile Product Manager with a primary focus on Firefox for iOS, while also contributing across mobile (including Android).</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This role is about building a better browser, turning downloads into loyal users, and creating experiences that truly stand out. If you’ve shipped mobile apps, obsess over details that improve everyday use, and love turning user insights into real improvements, this is a great opportunity to drive impact at Firefox.</span></p> <p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Build a fundamentally better browser experience: fix bugs, refine UI and navigation, improve downloads, menus, performance, and all the small details that make Firefox noticeably better for users who care about privacy, quality and reliability.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Drive strong activation and retention: focus on the new-user journey, quickly hooking people after they install the app, understanding where they drop off, and relentlessly optimizing the funnel through data, testing and iteration.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Deliver differentiating features and experiences that make Firefox stickier for key user groups, the kinds of things others can’t or won’t build.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Work closely with engineers, designers, data 400;">Stay deeply connected to real users: track App Store trends and discussions, test apps hands-on, analyze reviews and analytics, and turn those insights into concrete enhancements for Firefox on iOS and Android.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Monitor app health in App Store Connect and Google Play Console (crashes, ANRs, ratings) and support markets (Europe, Japan, Asia etc.), keeping cultural differences and local realities like data constraints in mind.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Proven Shipping Experience: Hands-on experience launching or managing apps on the iOS App Store and/or Google Play Store, with clear impact on user experience and metrics.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Execution Focus: A strong track record of delivering features and improvements under deadlines through effective collaboration with engineering, design and cross-functional partners.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mobile &amp; Browser Fluency: Deep understanding of iOS (and ideally Android) ecosystems, app store policies and web browser technologies, with genuine passion for what makes a great browsing experience.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Data-Driven Iteration: Comfort using analytics, funnels, A/B testing and user feedback to improve activation, retention and overall product quality.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">User Obsession: Natural habit of studying apps, following trends on platforms like X/Twitter and Reddit, and testing experiences yourself to uncover opportunities.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Global &amp; Growth Mindset: Interest or experience growing products in international markets with sensitivity to local user needs.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bonus:</span></li> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span app’s user base.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Currently maintaining your own side project or app on the App Store or Google Play.</span></li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll get:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success description: <h2 class="title">Company Description</h2> <p>ecosio is a fast-growing, innovative service company and a leading provider of B2B integration, specialising in electronic data interchange (EDI), Web EDI and e-invoicing. ecosio is part of Vertex, Inc., a leading global provider of indirect tax solutions listed on Nasdaq (VERX).</p> <p>Our brand slogan is&nbsp;<em>Connections That Work</em> as we believe strong connections are central to successful business relationships - both external and internal. At ecosio, we hire individuals from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment. We are technology lovers, set the highest standards for our solutions, and put innovative ideas first.</p> <h2 class="title">Job Description</h2> <p>We’re looking for a Product Owner to own our workflow platform end to end, make bold decisions and ship AI-native automation that transforms how ecosio works.</p> <p><strong>You'll connect with the role if you enjoy:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Having the freedom and accountability to challenge existing processes, prototype quickly and drive ideas through to company-wide adoption</li> <li>Taking ambiguous workflow problems from first insight to shipped solution and measurable impact</li> <li>Prioritizing features and enhancements based on business impact and user needs</li> <li>Designing intuitive user interfaces and experiences for internal applications with AI workflows in mind</li> <li>Working directly with teams to uncover high-leverage problems and turn them into clear product bets</li> <li>Conducting user training sessions and creating interactive documentation for clear user enablement and feature adoption</li> <li>Analyzing usage data to identify optimization opportunities, adoption and impact</li> <li>Collaborating daily with UI/UX designers and engineering teams to prototype, test, and ship high-impact tooling functionality</li> </ul> <h2 class="title">Qualifications</h2> <p><strong>To connect with ecosio, it is important to have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3–4 years of experience in product management or a related role, preferably in a SaaS environment (e.g. Project Management software, Configuration systems, Agent systems)</li> <li><strong>AI Native Expertise</strong> - an understanding of modern AI/ML technology (e.g. LLMs, RAGs, MCPs, agentic systems and other concepts) and ability to demonstrate how you build or optimize features and workflows with AI tools in your work or side projects</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic, evolving environment, embracing new priorities and challenges as opportunities to learn and grow. Curiosity, adaptability, disciplined execution and strategic communication are part of your core values</li> <li>A strong product vision and the ability to break the the big picture into small, shippable, impactful increments</li> <li>A mindset focused on how users think, ensuring our products and workflow tools are intuitive, efficient, and user-friendly</li> <li>Hands-on experience with agent building, prototyping/design tools, documentation/planning tools, ticketing systems, and analytics tools (e.g. Figma, Posthog,…)</li> </ul> <p>And nice to have:</p> <ul> <li>A technical background or education (HTL, FH, university,..)</li> <li>Background in workflow automation, process improvement, or configuring complex transactional systems/logs (e.g., document exchange or fintech)</li> <li>Knowledge of EDI concepts</li> </ul> <h2>Additional Information</h2> <p><strong>By connecting with us you will experience...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Our remote-first culture lets you work remotely from one of our designated countries</li> <li>Flexible working hours to suit your schedule and priorities</li> <li>Annual personal development budget to invest in conferences, courses, or career coaching</li> <li>Home office allowance to create a workspace that fits your needs</li> <li>Regular events and trips to connect, celebrate, and have fun with the team</li> <li>Workations of up to 90 days per year within the EU, combining travel and productivity</li> <li>Wellbeing support, including mental health resources and employee assistance programs</li> <li>Additional country-specific benefits based on your location&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Sounds like a connection that works? Then apply now and we will get in touch soon!</strong></p> <p>Our mission is to build Connections That Work by fostering a diverse and inclusive team. We are committed to making everyone feel valued and empowered to contribute their unique skills, experiences and perspectives. And now we want to connect with you.</p> <p>We use Metaview Notetaker to support interview documentation during our recruiting process. Further information on the processing of personal data can be found in our&nbsp;<a href="https://ecosio.com/en/data-protection/">Privacy Policy</a>.</p> <p>As part of our hiring process at ecosio, we conduct standard background checks. You can find more information about them by clicking&nbsp;<a href="https://ecosio.com/en/background-check/">HERE</a>.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Product Engineer
description: <h2><strong>About Parloa</strong></h2> <p>Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like <a href="http://booking.com">Booking.com</a>, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.</p> <h2><strong>About the role:</strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Staff Product Engineer</strong>, you will work directly inside our most strategic enterprise customers. You will build the software that makes their AI agents work in production, and be measured by the difference it makes for the customer.</p> <p>Our agents are built by business users in Parloa’s platform, AMP. AMP already comes with a broad library of tools and integrations. Your job is the part AMP does not cover yet for a given customer: the last connection into their systems, or a capability the product does not have. Our customers are large enterprises in financial services, telecom, insurance, travel and retail. For them, a working prototype is where an engagement starts, not where it ends.</p> <p>The work comes in two forms. Some engagements run for years. You stay with the account, deepen its integrations and help it grow into new use cases. Others are short experiments. You test a new idea with a real customer and decide quickly whether it is worth building. At Staff level, you take on the hardest cases of both: accounts where a pilot-grade solution would fail in production, and capabilities nobody at Parloa has built before. Staff means harder problems and more ambiguity, not less hands-on work.</p> <p>On many accounts, you work alongside a Deployment Strategist. Think of the two of you as the account’s leadership team. The Deployment Strategist acts as its CPO and defines what success looks like. You act as its CTO and own the architecture and the build. On accounts without a Deployment Strategist, you own the engineering yourself.</p> <h2><strong>Areas of ownership:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead the hardest engagements.</strong> Run complex programmes with several workstreams. Make the architecture decisions that span Parloa’s platform and several parts of the customer’s organization.</li> <li><strong>Build what AMP does not cover yet.</strong> Systems of record, telephony and contact-center integrations, state management, data readiness, multi-agent orchestration and retrieval. When the answer is unclear, build a prototype quickly and decide whether it is worth pursuing before Parloa invests a full quarter in it.</li> <li><strong>Own production quality and security.</strong> Evals, production readiness, observability and incident playbooks for enterprise-scale traffic. Meet the data handling standards a regulated customer expects, including PII, access control and audit trails. Debug live issues, whether they are technical or caused by model behaviour.</li> <li><strong>Grow the account, and share what belongs in the product.</strong> Drive the second use case, the second business unit, the renewal. Set the delivery standard for other engineers on complex accounts. When something you build would help every customer, flag it. That is how Parloa decides what goes into the core product.</li> <li><strong>Mentor other Product Engineers</strong>, and take part in interviewing and hiring.</li> <li><strong>Use AI well, and set the standard for it.</strong> Decide how AI-assisted work is validated before it reaches a customer’s production traffic.</li> <li><strong>Represent Parloa with senior technical stakeholders.</strong> Work directly with the customer’s principal engineers, architects and security leaders. Be the engineer commercial teams bring in when a prospect asks how the solution would work for them.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What this role is not:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Not running the Parloa platform itself.</strong> That is a separate engineering role. The platform is your foundation, and you build what a specific customer needs on top of it.</li> <li><strong>Not agent configuration.</strong> Business users design and configure agents in AMP. You build the integrations and capabilities those agents need.</li> <li><strong>Not a people-management role.</strong> You are an individual contributor and write and review code every week.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>OUR TECH STACK:</strong></h2> <p>Go, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, FastAPI, frontier LLMs, MCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka/NATS</p> <p>You will not use all of these, and most engagements add something new.</p> <h2><strong>Who you are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>8+ years of professional software development</strong>, delivering production systems end to end. Fluent in TypeScript or Python, or able to get there quickly.</li> <li><strong>5+ years leading the design and architecture of large-scale production systems</strong> in customer-facing or enterprise environments, with a focus on reliability, scale and failure modes.</li> <li><strong>Experience leading agentic, spec-driven development in production.</strong> You know when a coding agent’s output is wrong and what checks it needs before it ships.</li> <li><strong>A track record in long-term accounts or fast experiments.</strong> You have owned a strategic enterprise relationship over several years, through an expansion, a renewal or a leadership change. Or you have tested new ideas at the frontier and decided quickly whether they were worth building.</li> <li><strong>Experience as a mentor or tech lead</strong>, helping engineers become independent.</li> <li><strong>Comfortable with ambiguity and with customers.</strong> You work well in complex organizations, build trust quickly with new customer teams, spot risks early and keep your judgment when the stakes are high.</li> <li><strong>Willingness to travel up to 25%</strong> to customer sites, depending on the engagement.</li> <li>Strong spoken and written communication skills in English.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building or deploying an LLM-powered system used by real users in production</li> <li>Hands-on experience with eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering or multi-agent orchestration (few candidates will have all of these)</li> <li>A founder or founding-engineer background</li> <li>Forward-deployed, solutions engineering, product engineering or strategic-partner experience at an enterprise software or AI company</li> <li>Voice or conversational AI, or contact center, telephony or CCaaS integration</li> <li>Experience in regulated industries such as banking, insurance or telecom</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our engineering values:</strong></h3> <p>At Parloa, we hire, promote, and evaluate based on cultural and technical excellence. You’ll thrive here if you:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Earn Trust</strong> – act with transparency and reliability.</li> <li><strong>Obsess Over Customers</strong> – always start with the customer problem.</li> <li><strong>Think Big</strong> – set bold goals and pursue them fearlessly.</li> <li><strong>Have Integrity</strong> – do the right thing, especially when it’s hard.</li> <li><strong>Disagree &amp; Commit</strong> – debate with candor, align fast, and deliver.</li> <li><strong>Own It</strong> – take full responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.</li> <li><strong>Dive Deep</strong> – master the details without losing sight of the big picture.</li> <li><strong>Bias for Action</strong> – move fast, decide quickly, iterate fearlessly.</li> <li><strong>Deliver Value</strong> – measure success by customer and business impact.</li> <li><strong>Insist on the Highest Standards</strong> – raise the bar continuously.</li> <li><strong>Go the Extra Mile</strong> – make the impossible possible.</li> <li><strong>Hire &amp; Elevate the Best</strong> – raise the bar with every hire.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our recruiting process:</strong></h3> <p>Recruiter Call → Technical Peer Interview → 360° Tech Interview Loop → Bar Raiser</p> <h2><strong>Why Parloa?</strong></h2> <p>We’re at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn’t just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We’re building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren’t just support tickets; they’re defining experiences. We’re here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale—and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments—this is where you do it.</p> <p>At Parloa, ownership isn’t a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that’s evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.</p> <p>We’ve grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we’ve kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.</p> <p>Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we’re scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><iframe style="display: table; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/P4d-iyx7RQM" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p>Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.</p> <p>Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. <a class="c-link" href="https://www.e-verify.gov/about-e-verify/what-is-e-verify" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.e-verify.gov/about-e-verify/what-is-e-verify" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Please click here to learn more</a>.</p> <p><strong>* </strong><strong>We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, national origin, disability status, socioeconomic background and other characteristics.</strong></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Partnerships Manager: Media & Editorial (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>Awin's Unlock the Clock (UTC) programme is building the evidence base and infrastructure to move measurement beyond last click, using deterministic, CDN/edge-level signals and advanced data connections from publishers to show the full-funnel and AI-discovery influence that today's attribution misses. The value of that dataset scales with the quality and scale of the publishers inside it.</p> <p>This role exists to acquire and retain those publishers. The Senior Partnerships Manager, Media &amp; Data owns the end-to-end pursuit of medium-to-large global media publications and publisher groups, from first conversation to signature, to live, verified data flowing, and is responsible for building the commercial value exchange that makes Awin the leading partner for a premium publisher to work with. The focus in year one is a small number of flagship, tier-one lighthouse partnerships that prove the model and become the reference cases the rest of the market follows.</p> <p>This is a new, dedicated role. It is not general publisher account management: the postholder is hired to spearhead these relationships and nothing else.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Land flagship media partnerships</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and own a global target list of medium-to-large media publications and publisher groups whose audience, content and commerce activity make them high-value contributors to Awin’s deterministic dataset.</li> <li>Own the full pursuit cycle for those targets: identify, qualify, pitch, negotiate, close and hand into onboarding, personally leading senior conversations with commercial, ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.</li> <li>Deliver a defined number of tier-one lighthouse partnerships in year one: signed tracking addendum, technically onboarded, and verifiably recording events at agreed volume and quality thresholds.</li> <li>Convert those wins into reference cases, including case studies, joint narratives and referenceable contacts, that materially shorten the sales cycle for the next tranche of publishers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build the publisher value proposition</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and continuously sharpen the answer to “what’s in it for the publisher”: the commercial, editorial and strategic reasons a premium media owner shares CDN and wider data signals with Awin.</li> <li>Construct and negotiate the value exchange, including new revenue lines, advertiser demand, insight and benchmarking, or commercial terms</li> <li>Work with Product, Marketing and the workstream owners to translate AI-visibility and full-funnel capability into publisher-facing propositions, collateral and retailer pricing</li> <li>Help each partner build their own value proposition, so the publisher has something new and differentiated to sell to advertisers, not simply a new tag on their site.</li> <li>Equip partners to sell that proposition through joint collateral, benchmarks, proof points and training for their commercial and editorial teams.</li> <li>Feed publisher objections, commercial expectations and market intelligence back into the project roadmap so the product earns the deals rather than the deals stretching the product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own the technical and contractual path to live</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run the integration conversation with publishes, covering CDN/edge worker or plugin deployment, tag and consent implications, data scope and page performance, with Awin product brought in for deep technical detail.</li> <li>Own the commercial and legal process end to end, including tracking addendum, data-sharing terms, privacy and consent positions, working with Legal and Privacy to reach repeatable rather than bespoke agreements.</li> <li>Hold partners accountable to going live and staying live, tracking signed-to-verified-event conversion</li> </ul> <p><strong>Global reach and internal leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operate globally from day one across UK, EU and US, coordinating with local Awin market and Publisher Development teams and identified regional representatives rather than duplicating them.</li> <li>Act as the single point of accountability and internal voice for media partner acquisition within the project: represent the workstream in relevant forums and provide clear, honest pipeline and progress reporting to SteerCo level.</li> <li>Partner with the advertiser-facing teams so publisher supply and advertiser demand are sequenced together: the data has to be sold on as well as signed up.</li> <li>Represent Awin externally at key industry events, conferences and partner forums to promote Unlock the Clock and Awin’s fuller-funnel measurement strategy to the media community.</li> <li>Build the playbook: document what works, so the model can be scaled by others and, in time, by a small team reporting into this role.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Success measures (first 12 months)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Signed and live tier-one lighthouse partnerships against an agreed target, evidenced by verified event volume</li> <li>A qualified, weighted global pipeline of medium-to-large media groups with credible forward visibility.</li> <li>A repeatable publisher proposition and commercial framework: not a series of bespoke negotiations.</li> <li>Partner-facing value propositions live in market, with at least two partners actively selling an Awin-enabled proposition of their own.</li> <li>Referenceable partners willing to advocate publicly, at least one flagship case study in market, and Awin represented on stage at relevant industry events.</li> <li>Measurable advertiser-side pull-through from the partnerships landed, agreed jointly with the advertiser teams.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Key description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2><strong>About this role</strong></h2> <p>Our website is one of the most important ways people discover what we offer, understand our value, and decide whether to talk to Sales or start a trial. The Web Growth team owns its roadmap and continuously improves the journey from first impression through to lead capture, demo engagement, signup, and trial start.</p> <p>You’ll treat the website like a product: understand user intent, find confusion and friction, form strong hypotheses, test them with users and data, and turn what you learn into better experiences.</p> <p>You’ll be just as comfortable shaping the problem and influencing the roadmap as you are designing the final interaction, prototype, or page.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experimentation:</strong> Designing and iterating on experiments across landing pages, pricing, signup, and conversion flows to improve engagement, conversion, qualified leads, and trial starts.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration:</strong> Working with Growth, Self-serve, Brand, Marketing, Product, Data, Research, and Engineering to turn opportunities into clear, buildable experiences.</li> <li><strong>Data and insight:</strong> Using user insights and funnel data to identify opportunities, define hypotheses, and measure impact.</li> <li><strong>Product design:</strong> Applying product design thinking to comprehension, navigation, forms, interactive demos, responsiveness, and accessibility.</li> <li><strong>Prototyping and systems:</strong> Prototyping in Figma and code, using AI tools where useful, and working within shared components and brand systems.</li> <li><strong>Roadmap ownership:</strong> Bringing ideas to the Web Growth roadmap, not just executing briefs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Must have experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years in web, product, growth, or a closely related design role, with a strong portfolio of shipped, conversion-focused work.</li> <li><strong>Growth mindset:</strong> A track record of using design, growth frameworks, conversion rate optimisation, and funnel analysis to improve outcomes such as leads, conversion, trials, activation, or revenue.</li> <li><strong>Experimentation:</strong> Experience designing and iterating on experiments, including A/B tests or other data-informed approaches. B2B SaaS experience is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Craft and taste:</strong> Excellent visual and interaction design skills, with a sharp eye for typography, hierarchy, detail, and polish.</li> <li><strong>Systems and brand:</strong> Comfortable working within an existing design system and brand, while identifying opportunities to extend and improve it.</li> <li><strong>AI fluency:</strong> Experience using AI in your design practice, including tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Figma Make, or similar. You should be able to explain how AI has changed your workflow and what you have built or shipped with it.</li> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> Able to take a brief and run with it. You work independently, make good decisions, ask the right questions, and bring solutions rather than just options.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who this role is not for</strong></h2> <p>This role is not for you if:</p> <ul> <li>You only want to design campaign or marketing pages from a fixed brief. This role owns the journey from first visit through to lead, demo, signup, or trial.</li> <li>You care about visual polish but not about comprehension, navigation, forms, interactive demos, or reducing friction.</li> <li>You don’t want to work with funnel data, user research, experimentation, or the realities of implementation.</li> <li>You want to focus on brand expression without balancing it with usability, accessibility, performance, and measurable growth.</li> <li>You need a fixed roadmap and detailed requirements rather than identifying opportunities and shaping what the team should test next.</li> <li>You’re not interested in working closely with Growth, Marketing, Product, Data, Research, and Engineering to make the website perform better.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>You’ll know you’re successful if:</p> <ul> <li>More visitors understand Fin and Intercom, find the right path for their needs, and take the next step with less friction.</li> <li>You’ve improved meaningful growth outcomes across qualified leads, demo engagement, signups, and trial starts.</li> <li>Experiments are well designed, clearly measured, and used to inform what the team does next.</li> <li>You’ve made complex product value easier to understand and act on without relying on extra explanation from Sales or Marketing.</li> <li>You’ve built strong working relationships with Growth, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Sales, and Customer Success.</li> <li>You’ve raised the bar for web growth design through thoughtful, high-quality experiences that people trust and want to use.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Interview process</strong></h2> <p>We understand that interviewing for a new role is both time- and energy-consuming. We aim to be thorough, speedy, and transparent in our approach.</p> <p>You should expect the entire process to take no more than four weeks from start to finish. You’ll meet with members of our team and have the opportunity to validate that Intercom and the role are the right fit for you.</p> <h2><strong>Ready to build something great?</strong></h2> <p>If you’re excited by the opportunity to help existing businesses get more value from a self-serve product, and you have the craft, curiosity, commercial thinking, and autonomy to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey.
